groups.defect: translate (and ensure_loaded!) only load the current locale, so fallback-chain locales are never loaded outside ApplicationController#set_locale (jobs, with_locale, mailers), which causes missing translations.
groups.rationale: Both report the same defect in the same lines and propose the same fix: load the whole fallback chain in translate.

groups.defect: FallbackLocaleList#[] calls to_sym on a possibly nil SiteSetting.default_locale, which raises NoMethodError before compact runs. It also mixes String and Symbol locales, which breaks uniq and the @loaded_locales check.
groups.rationale: These overlap: s_006ed08a and s_e63608d7 report both defects, s_c8aed49e reports only the String/Symbol mix, and s_9009c9ce reports only the nil to_sym crash. Together they form one chain on the same line.
